description: Trim or extend layers' In or Out point to a time (Alt+[ and Alt+]: trim to the current time), or trim a set of layers together so the earliest In point or latest Out point lands there, keeping their offsets. Trimming never changes the source

asSet.description: Trim the layers as a set: the earliest In (or latest Out) point goes to the time and the others keep their offsets. Default false

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

name: trim_layers
title: Trim Layers
